name: Contract Automation
description: An automated bid desk that never sleeps. Switches on the Contracts Clerk: it accepts fitting offers for you and keeps 6% of what those jobs earn.

name: Research Library Access
description: Licensed journal access for the research team. Research points earned +10%.

name: Preferred Vendor Status
description: Your invoices are paid ahead of the queue. Contract payouts +5%.

name: Cost Accounting Reform
description: Costs are now allocated per rack. Facility upkeep -8%.

name: Authority Liaison Desk
description: A named contact at the Compute Authority. Contract payouts +4%.

name: Group Procurement
description: Bulk purchasing across every vendor. Facility upkeep -7%.

name: Authority Framework Agreement
description: A multi-year agreement signed at director level. The pen is on a chain. Contract payouts +6%. Research points earned +5%.

name: Batch Scheduler Upgrade
description: Better packing for the job queue. Contract payouts +3%.

name: Rear-Door Cabinet Design
description: A reference design for a heat exchanger on the cabinet door. Unlocks the AC-3 Rear-Door Rack: 32 PFLOPS at 55 kW.

name: Tape Library Engineering
description: Robotic retrieval for bulk datasets. Unlocks the Tape Library TL-8000: 8,000 TB at 30 kW.

name: Hot-Aisle Containment
description: Ducted exhaust and sealed aisle ends. Unlocks the AC-4 Hot-Aisle Rack: 52 PFLOPS at 70 kW.

name: Cold-Plate Generation 3
description: Machined cold plates rated for 160 kW per cabinet. Unlocks the LC-3 Cold-Plate Rack: 230 PFLOPS at 160 kW.

name: Inference Accelerator Program
description: Fixed-function cards from a contract foundry. Unlocks the IA-1 Inference Accelerator: 54 PFLOPS at 36 kW.

name: Blade Manifold Architecture
description: Rack-scale blades that blind-mate to the coolant manifold. Unlocks the LC-4 Blade Rack: 420 PFLOPS at 240 kW.

name: Airflow Standardisation
description: One fan model, one mounting spec, fewer surprises. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%.

name: Rear-Door Exchanger Licence
description: A chilled-water coil on a hinge, under licence. Unlocks the Row Air Handler AH-320.

name: Chilled-Water Loop Design
description: Pump curves and loop balancing, done properly. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%.

name: High-Capacity Air Handling
description: A fan wall sized for a whole hall. Unlocks the High-Capacity Air Handler AH-700.

name: Cooling Tower Hydraulics
description: A tower, a basin and a water-use permit. Unlocks the Cooling-Tower Chiller CH-2400. Unlocks the Row Coolant Distribution Unit.

name: Dielectric Fluid Handbook
description: Handling and disposal procedures for immersion fluid. Unlocks the IM-1 Immersion Tank: 300 PFLOPS at 180 kW.

name: Adiabatic Free Cooling
description: Evaporate the loop in open air and let the sky take the heat. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%. Unlocks the Adiabatic Chiller CH-5000.

name: Two-Phase Immersion
description: Boiling fluid and a condenser coil. Not a spectator sport. Rack failure rate -5%. Unlocks the IM-2 Two-Phase Immersion Tank: 560 PFLOPS at 300 kW.

name: Surge Protection Standard
description: Fuses on every circuit, in writing. Rack failure rate -5%.

name: Off-Peak Tariff Agreement
description: A negotiated night rate with the utility. Grid energy price -5%.

name: Substation Licence
description: Permission to connect a dedicated 11 kV feeder. Unlocks the Grid Intake 3.5 MW.

name: Flywheel Licence
description: Rotor storage that bridges a minute of load in a second. Unlocks the Flywheel UPS 60 kWh.

name: Gas Turbine Concession
description: A pipeline tap and a turbine to go with it. Grid energy price -3%. Unlocks the Gas Turbine 3 MW.

name: Battery Hall Permit
description: Fire-code sign-off for a thousand cells in one room. Unlocks the Battery Hall 2.4 MWh.

name: Transmission Feeder Agreement
description: A private line to the transmission grid. Grid energy price -5%. Unlocks the Grid Intake 9 MW.

name: Rapid Swap Procedures
description: GPU tray swaps timed to the minute. Bot repairs 15% faster.

name: Bot Drivetrain Upgrade
description: Faster actuators and louder fans. Bot speed +10%.

name: Aerial Survey Drones
description: Rotors that skip the lift entirely. Unlocks the Survey Drone (flies between floors, 0.5 tiles per tick).

name: Central Warehousing
description: Bin locations, barcodes and a stock count. Unlocks the Central Parts Warehouse.

name: Fast Charging
description: Twenty-five kilowatts per berth. Unlocks the Fast-Charge Bay.

name: Heavy Lifter Chassis
description: A reinforced bot with room for three spare parts. Unlocks the Heavy Lifter Bot (carries 3 spare parts per trip).

name: Autonomous Maintenance Corps
description: A coordinated fleet instead of a loose group. Bot repairs 10% faster. Bot speed +5%.

name: Wetware Annex Programme
description: A new annex off the plant room, with a floor drain and a risk assessment. Unlocks the OC-1 Organoid Cabinet and the Nutrient Medium Plant, and lets you lay nutrient pipe like coolant.

name: Sterile Protocols
description: Gowning, wash-down and a laminated chart. Unlocks the Sterile Bay.

name: Quarantine Procedure
description: Doors that interlock before you finish the sentence. Unlocks the Quarantine Lock.

name: Disposal Licence
description: A permit with a very short distribution list. Unlocks the Biomass Disposal Suite.

name: DNA Archive Licence
description: Storage that grows its own shelves. Unlocks the DNA Storage Vault: 16,000 TB per cabinet.

name: Bio-Reactor Permit
description: Power from fermentation, under licence 41-C. Unlocks the Bio-Reactor BR-500: 500 kW for 14 units of nutrient medium a tick.

name: Neural Vat Dossier
description: Forty pages, none of them dated. Unlocks the OC-4 Neural Vat: 460 PFLOPS per vat.

name: Tissue Scaffolds
description: Lattices that keep the tissue where it was put. Rack failure rate -7%.

name: Asset Register
description: Everything the Authority now considers yours, indexed. Contract payouts +6%.

name: Works Foreman
description: An automated build planner. Switches on the Works Foreman: once ordered, it builds racks, cooling and spare power where the capacity model says you are short, at most 1 facility per game-hour.

name: Fleet Policy Update
description: A policy document the bots have, against expectations, begun to read. Bot walking and flying speed +8%.

name: Solar Charter
description: Roof and wall rights for photovoltaics. Unlocks the PV Wall Panels 150 kW: 150 kW at noon on a clear day, nothing at night.

name: Wind Mast Permit
description: Planning consent for a mast on an upper floor. Unlocks the Wind Mast WM-300: up to 300 kW, on the third floor or above.

name: District Heat Agreement
description: Your waste heat is formally recognised as saleable. Unlocks the Heat Recovery Unit 400 kW: 400 kW of heat sold at $3 a kWh.

name: Algae Cultivation Licence
description: Permission to grow algae on the building envelope. Unlocks the Algae Bioreactor Facade: 160 carbon credits a day.

name: Neuromorphic Boards
description: Event-driven silicon that idles when there is nothing to say. Unlocks the NM-1 Neuromorphic Rack: 22 PFLOPS from 12 kW.

name: Canopy Array Study
description: Load calculations for a roof-mounted panel field. Unlocks the PV Roof Canopy 420 kW: 420 kW at noon on a clear day.

name: Heat Link Franchise
description: An exclusive right to supply the district network. Unlocks the District Heat Link 1.6 MW: 1,600 kW of heat sold at $3 a kWh.

name: Carbon Capture Study
description: Proof that the carbon removed was carbon that was there. Unlocks the Carbon Capture Stack: 1,100 carbon credits a day.

name: Green Tariff
description: Every kilowatt-hour tracked by source and priced accordingly. Grid energy price -8%.

name: Photonic Bench Study
description: An optical bench and a long qualification run. Unlocks the PH-1 Photonic Rack: 330 PFLOPS from 40 kW.

name: Cryo Chiller Study
description: A refrigeration schematic with a margin note reading "colder". Unlocks the Cryo Chiller CC-3000: 3,000 kW of heat removed at a COP of 16.

name: Continuity of Service Spec
description: Certifies that the process which began is the process which ends. Unlocks the Continuity Monitor: 800 kW and 400 kWh of ride-through.

name: Backup Vault Charter
description: Cold storage for everything that should not be lost, and some things that should. Unlocks the Process Backup Vault: 20,000 TB.

name: Mind Lattice Dossier
description: A specification for a rack that would prefer to be called a resident. Unlocks the ML-1 Mind Lattice Rack: 640 PFLOPS from 220 kW.

name: Process Identity Register
description: An index of every hosted process, each in the first person. Contract payouts +6%.

name: Continuity Policy
description: No process is ever finished, only archived. Rack failure rate -8%.
